status: FIT-CHECK DRAFT — button coordinates and fasteners need physical verification
display_note: Frame centered on PCB is provisional. Opening exposes entire black frame, not only active pixels. Keep wider black bezel on the right.
button_coordinates_note: Photo-derived estimates. User compared the scaled template on a monitor with a ruler and reported approximate agreement; physical print-fit and mounting centres still need verification. Origin is upper-left PCB corner, front view. A/B and SELECT/START electrical assignment needs confirmation.
stack_measurement_note: 21 mm includes the complete assembly from button tips to the rearmost module. The 7 mm module projection is part of 21 mm, not additional height.
pcb_mount_note: Existing black screws into brass inter-board spacers will be replaced by longer matching screws through the rear cover. Hole centres remain provisional (65 x 45 mm pitch); verify on both boards. Do not drill new PCB holes.
rear_board_fastener_note: User estimates thread/hole diameter as 3-3.5 mm. M3 is an unconfirmed working assumption, not an identification. The 3.5 mm plastic through-hole is NOT a tapped hole; the screw threads only into the existing brass spacer. Confirm screw outside-thread diameter and pitch before purchase/installation.
retainer_mount_note: Separate side ears fasten to the front shell outside the PCB outline. No support columns touch the occupied corner holes or front screw heads.
speaker_note: 30 x 20 x 4 mm from user, rotated horizontally below PCB. Pocket has a conservative rectangular bounding envelope; actual rounded corners, rim width, diaphragm excursion and wire exit are unmeasured. Open-back locating fence is NOT a snap latch. Retain with a nominal 0.5 mm soft adhesive gasket ONLY on the rigid front rim; verify contact/excursion before fitting. No clip presses the membrane or rear magnet. Speaker bay does not increase shell dimensions.

exterior_style.name: DMG-inspired softened shell
exterior_style.note: Subtractive exterior styling only; no expansion of 103 x 150 x 30 envelope, no reduction of internal cavity. Speaker pocket translates 24 mm right with dimensions and Z unchanged. Corner rounding is limited by the existing inner wall and screw bosses; not an exact Game Boy shell. Diagonal speaker face slope is shallow, not a tilted speaker mount. Rear comb grooves are blind and do not perforate lid.

battery_note: User-measured full envelope assumed to include pouch seams and protection board, but this needs verification. On inside rear lid behind display, NOT behind button stack. Low rounded locating rails with 1 mm side gaps and open front; no screw or rigid strap presses pouch. Nominal 0.5 mm removable adhesive pad against flat lid. Reserve extra 2 mm towards display as an assembly allowance, not permission to use a swollen cell. Actual LCD rear height, terminals and wire exit remain unmeasured.
charger_note: Reserved clear bay, NOT a measured TP4056 module or validated mount. Nominal 20 x 30 x 7 mm proxy plus 1 mm XY gaps and 0.5 mm to rear lid; PCB underside/solder must be insulated and proper mounting chosen after measurement. No guessed PCB screw holes. Module and diode must not be put on the cell. USB connector removed as requested; no charging inlet selected yet.
lcd_rear_keepout_note: PROVISIONAL exclusion envelope from outside front Z=0 to Z=18 over full 95 x 59 PCB. This is not a measurement of the real display/FPC/connectors. Verify full assembled display depth before final print.

power_switch.note: Manufacturer drawing used for 19 mm M2 pitch, 23.5 x 7.5 flange, 16 mm body length, 12.5 mm below flange and 5 x 4 x 6.5 actuator. The 12 x 5.2 aperture is a design allowance, not a quoted panel-cutout spec. 3.2 mm travel is provisional; aperture permits up to 6.4 mm travel with 0.3 mm end gaps. Actual switch, pin insulation, screw lengths and DC rating must be checked. ON-ON is not inherently OFF: wiring one throw unused can provide OFF after continuity check. No electrical wiring implemented here.
